title: Adorable 1 Bedroom Guest Cottage in East Nashville
description:
Adorable artists' cottage. Extremely cozy with everything you need for your stay. Past guests really love the bed and have commented how comfortable it is. No cleaning required at check out! Walk to Rosepepper, Jeni's Icecream, 2 Ten Jack and more of East Nashville's favorite spots. Lovely and walkable neighborhood.  Perfect location! Permit #2022056723

The space
This is a studio space and is all one room (except for the bathroom).

Guest access
This is a totally separate house, so you will have access to the entire house and outdoor area.
